artifacts.text: Pitfall: ambient same-UID credential authority. Filtering the worker's env does not isolate git credential helpers, `~/.git-credentials`, `gh auth`, or `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`; those resolve per-user, so any same-UID process can reach them. Gate credential lookup as a separate step: resolve transport auth only in an owner-held context after an explicit push grant keyed to the sealed SHA, re-check that SHA at push time, and never pass the token into worker-reachable env.
